name: Sachin Jain
player_statement:
A complete player, Sachin Jain has made a big mark in cricket. With 63 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 49, with an average of 11.62 and a quick strike rate of 118.92. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 20 sixes and 58 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 11.1 overs, taking 6 wickets at an economy rate of 12.36. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
